args:
set -euo pipefail

test -f ig.ini

# Install the tools needed by the IG build.
apt-get update

apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  openjdk-17-jdk-headless \
  graphviz \
  jekyll \
  python3 \
  curl \
  ca-certificates \
  git

npm install --global fsh-sushi

# Print tool versions for later troubleshooting.
java -version
node --version
sushi --version
jekyll --version
dot -V

# Download the same Publisher used by your workflow.
mkdir -p input-cache

curl --fail --location --show-error --retry 3 \
  https://github.com/HL7/fhir-ig-publisher/releases/download/2.3.4/publisher.jar \
  --output input-cache/publisher.jar

# Remove old generated results from the build workspace.
rm -rf output temp

# Build with terminology validation enabled.
java -jar input-cache/publisher.jar \
  -ig . \
  -tx https://tx.fhir.org/r4 \
  -publish "https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore/${TAG_NAME}"

# Check that a website was generated.
test -s output/index.html

# Check the Publisher QA report.
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("output/qa.json")

if not path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("FAILED: output/qa.json is missing.")

qa = json.loads(path.read_text())
errors = qa.get("errs")

if type(errors) is not int or errors < 0:
    raise SystemExit(
        "FAILED: qa.json has no valid integer error count."
    )

print(f"QA errors: {errors}")
print(f"QA warnings: {qa.get('warnings', 'unknown')}")

if errors > 0:
    raise SystemExit(
        "FAILED: IG validation errors were found."
    )

print("PASSED: PH Core built with zero QA errors.")
PY

printf '%s\n' "$COMMIT_SHA" > output/BUILT_COMMIT
printf '%s\n' "$TAG_NAME" > output/BUILT_TAG


# Check publication package metadata before archiving.
python3 - <<'CHECK_PACKAGE'
import json
import tarfile

tag = "${TAG_NAME}"
expected_version = tag.removeprefix("v")
expected_url = f"https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore/{tag}"

with tarfile.open("output/package.tgz", "r:gz") as archive:
    member = archive.extractfile("package/package.json")
    if member is None:
        raise SystemExit("FAILED: package/package.json is missing.")
    package = json.load(member)

checks = {
    "package ID": package.get("name") == "fhir.ph.core",
    "version": package.get("version") == expected_version,
    "canonical": package.get("canonical")
        == "https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore",
    "publication URL": package.get("url") == expected_url,
    "publication flag": package.get("notForPublication", False) is False,
    "FHIR version": package.get("fhirVersions") == ["4.0.1"],
}

print(json.dumps(package, indent=2))

for name, passed in checks.items():
    print(f"{name}: {'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'}")

if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit("FAILED: publication package metadata.")

print("PASSED: publication package metadata.")
CHECK_PACKAGE

tar -C output -czf phcore-release.tar.gz .
sha256sum phcore-release.tar.gz > phcore-release.sha256
